plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<%= nextRelease.notes %>

### Images

For amd64 and arm64, published by the release workflow a few minutes after this release: `ghcr.io/maxgfr/troupe`, `troupe-renderer`, `troupe-ollama`, `troupe-web` and `troupe-cli`, each tagged `<%= nextRelease.version %>`. To run this version, set `TROUPE_VERSION=<%= nextRelease.version %>` in `.env` ([SELF-HOSTING.md](https://github.com/maxgfr/troupe/blob/<%= nextRelease.gitTag %>/docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)).

### CLI

`brew install maxgfr/tap/troupe`, or the standalone binaries (no Node.js) for macOS and Linux, arm64 and x64: `troupe-macos-arm64`, `troupe-macos-x64`, `troupe-linux-arm64`, `troupe-linux-x64`, attached by the release workflow a few minutes after this release, their sums added to `SHA256SUMS`. With Node.js 22+, `troupe-cli-<%= nextRelease.version %>.mjs` is the same CLI in one file.
